new_findings.text: The ledger's '+1AP per stat point' has a specific, citable android source, and it is NOT the auto-allocator the packet blamed. Android v0.682's manual stat panel InventoryUI.as:2429-2434 is `APaddHandle` -> `StatsManager.addMaxAP(1)`, with siblings +5 MAXHP (:2417), +5 MAXCHI (:2424), +1 ATK (:2439), +1 DEF (:2446), +1 SPD (:2453). The android auto-allocator at StatsManager.as:1669-1683 independently reads +5/+5/+1/+1. The web v0.717 twin (§1t5957s0§ binds the identical `this.statsPanel.HPadd` member at :3334) grants 10/5/5/3/3/3. So RR:77 and RR:199's '+10HP/+5Chi/+1AP/+3-stat' is a TWO-BUILD HYBRID: +10HP and +3-stat are web values, +1AP is the android value, and no single build ever shipped that line.
new_findings.ledger_text: - **Ready:** +3 stat/+1 skill/full refill per level; +10HP/+5Chi/+1AP/+3-stat per point; ...
new_findings.lane_impact: L4 progression - gives the '+5AP vs +1AP' correction a build-attributed source instead of a guess, so the ledger line can be rewritten as two labelled rows rather than one contested number.

new_findings.text: The per-stat CEILINGS are on disk in both builds as level formulas, and they arithmetically corroborate the per-point tables. WEB v0.717 (§1t5957s0§.as:3341-3346): MAXHP < 10+(level+10)*10, MAXCHI < 10+(level+10)*5, MAXAP < 30+(level+10)*5, ATK/DEF/SPD < 1+(level+10)*3. ANDROID v0.682 (InventoryUI.as:2407-2412): MAXHP < 10+(level+10)*5, MAXCHI < 10+(level+10)*5, MAXAP < 20+(level+10), ATK/DEF/SPD < level+10. Each build's caps are exactly its per-point grant times the point budget, which independently confirms web = 10/5/5/3/3/3 and android = 5/5/1/1/1/1. The web bases 10 / 10 / 30 also match the ledger's recorded start pools HP10 / Chi10 / AP30.
new_findings.ledger_text: - **Surface:** the per-point stat table + `atkPlusWeapon` term are solved but scattered; ... The "271 cap" is gear/rebirth-inclusive ...
new_findings.lane_impact: L4 progression - RR:201's '271 cap' surface note can be replaced by an exact per-stat cap formula per build; no arithmetic reconstruction needed.

new_findings.text: The WEB per-point stat table is confirmed by film, not only by decompile. In reference/videos/zFtCaTO0_1M.mp4 the character screen at -ss 653.0 reads level 3 with HP 20/20, CHI 10/10, AP 30/30, ATK 7, DEF 7, SPD 4 and AVAILABLE STAT POINTS: 0; at -ss 1600 it reads level 4 with HP 20/20, CHI 9/15, AP 15/30, ATK 10, DEF 10, SPD 4 and again 0 points available. The level-up therefore spent exactly three points and bought MAXCHI +5, ATK +3 and DEF +3 - matching the web handlers (§1t5957s0§.as:3406 +5 CHI, :3422 +3 ATK, :3434 +3 DEF) and matching the ledger's '+3 stat points per level'. It also rules android's +5/+1/+1 out on camera. HP 20 against a base of 10 needs a single +10 web point; android's +5 would need two.

new_findings.text: The film evidence the ledger's hard-lock sentence rests on is reconcilable with the live stance switch, and the reconciliation is in the web BattleUI. §1t113s0§.as:326-343 draws the reload/crit bar as (reload - 48) / (maxreload - 48) - the bar only begins to fill ABOVE 48, the exact stance-switch threshold - and drives one text field off that value: at bar == 0 it shows §1t5204s0§, a GREY (#BBBBBB) label built at :111 from getString(960); between 0 and 1 the label is hidden; at bar >= 1 it swaps to §1t5203s0§ = getString(175) = 'Critical Hit' and fires Snd_criticalDamage. String 960 is used at exactly one site in the whole web payload and does NOT exist in the android v0.682 table, so it is a web-only string I cannot resolve to text - but its slot is precisely where a 'CANNOT CHANGE STANCE' readout would live, and the label is BAR-STATE driven, not battle-state driven. That is a Focus-insufficiency indicator, not a hard lock.
new_findings.ledger_text: **In-combat stance is HARD-LOCKED in v0.717** ("CANNOT CHANGE STANCE").
new_findings.lane_impact: L8 ui-hud + L5 combat - removes the last defence of RR:158. PARTIAL because string 960's text is web-only and unresolved; resolving it would close the sentence outright.

new_findings.text: Three of the four crop tiers can rot; the fourth cannot. InteractUI_crops.as:55 declares `internal var gracePeriod:int = 900;` (15 minutes). The 15-minute (:116-128), 1-hour (:131-143) and 6-hour (:146-158) crops each run PLANTED / READYFORHARVEST-within-grace / ROTTED. The 12-hour crop at :161-169 has only PLANTED else READYFORHARVEST - no grace term and no ROTTED arm at all. A recreation that applies a uniform 900-second spoil window to all four crops is wrong on the highest tier.
new_findings.quote: InteractUI_crops.as:161-169 `case 4: this.timePeriod = 12 * 60 * 60; if(QueryManager.instance.getServerTime() - this.plantTime < this.timePeriod) { this.vegState = this.PLANTED; } else { this.vegState = this.READYFORHARVEST; }`
new_findings.lane_impact: L10 world-exploration - corrects the farm-timer finding in this same packet before it reaches config.

new_findings.text: The room-object dead list does not delete ore deposits, it re-creates them depleted. GameStage.as:633 exempts six object ids from suppression, and ore is one of them: GameStage.as:792-793 is `case 30: obj = new Obj_OreDeposit(objProperty,objName);`, and :647-650 re-creates a dead id-30 object with ',1' appended to its property string. Obj_OreDeposit.as:19-24 reads that flag and does gotoAndStop(1) with canInteract=false and buttonMode=false. So the mined-out rock is still drawn, in its spent frame, and simply cannot be interacted with. Ids 18, 19, 22 and 58 get the same ',1' treatment and id 33 (lever) gets property[1]='2'.
new_findings.quote: GameStage.as:647-650 `else if(skipFlag && xml.id == 30) { this.createRoomObject(xml.id,xml.x,ypos,xml.property + ",1",xml.name); }` · Obj_OreDeposit.as:19-23 `if(strArray.length > 1 && strArray[1] == "1") { gotoAndStop(1); canInteract = false;`
new_findings.lane_impact: L10 world-exploration - a recreation coded from 'suppress objects in the dead list' would render a missing rock instead of a spent one.

new_findings.text: The War Room frame nobody mined carries four unclaimed meta-social numbers, and one of them contests the ledger. reference/frames/Nr4fQstqHDM/seg-20/frames/frame_0014.jpg reads, along its bottom rail: 'ALLEGIANCE: CLAN AKA RYU', 'RANK: RECRUIT (3 MOVES A TURN)', 'MOVES MADE: 0/36', and on the right '3 MOVE(S) LEFT', with 'FLAGS INDICATE BATTLES THAT THE CLANS ARE CURRENTLY ENGAGED IN' and a 'SHOW CLAN MSG' button; the header reads 'CLAN CROPS: 402 (+2 HQ)'. The shipped UI says A TURN, in the game's own copy, and pairs a per-turn allowance of 3 with a 0/36 running counter - so 36 is a counter denominator sitting beside a 3-per-turn allowance, not evidence that 'moves per turn' means 'per hour'.
new_findings.ledger_text: - **Surface:** War-Room numbers already in config are now primary-confirmed (upgrade citations); "moves per turn" reconciles as "per hour" (36 = Private's rank threshold, not a turn cap);
new_findings.quote: On screen: 'RANK: RECRUIT (3 MOVES A TURN)' / 'MOVES MADE: 0/36' / '3 MOVE(S) LEFT'
new_findings.lane_impact: L12 meta-social - RR:247's 'reconciles as per hour' is contradicted by the shipped UI copy; the frame wins and the reconciliation needs redoing.

new_findings.text: The 800x690 vs 800x480 conflict resolves cleanly and neither number is wrong. BOTH the outer loader the browser embeds (reference/preservation/shs3.swf) and the decoded payload (reference/decrypted/shs3_payload_decoded.swf) declare an identical stage RECT of 800.0 x 690.0 at 24.000 fps - I parsed both headers. The GAME VIEWPORT is 800 x 480: the full-screen hurt vignette art inside the payload measures exactly 800x480, the BattleUI's skill-slot row sits at y=450, and the filmed content region is 1816 x 1080 = 1.681 aspect = 5:3. So 690 is the embed/authoring stage that carries chrome outside the play area, and RR:117 / RR:171's 800x480 native canvas stands as the viewport.

new_findings.lane_impact: L8 ui-hud - settles the 800x690 challenge without discarding the 800x480 canvas; both go in the ledger with their scopes named.

new_findings.text: The ledger calls 0.9 / 1.2 / 1.4 the 'MASTERY-9 CEILING'. The web formula does not reach 0.9 at mastery 9: §1t99s0§.as:3262 is base * (0.5 + 0.4 * lightMastery * 0.1), which gives 0.86 at m=9 and exactly 0.90 at m=10; balanced at :3265 is base * (1 + 0.2 * balancedMastery * 0.1), giving 1.18 at m=9 and exactly 1.20 at m=10. The string table independently names the ceiling: strings.json["8131"], ["8132"] and ["8133"] are the achievements 'Light Stance Mastery Level 10.', 'Balanced Stance Mastery Level 10.' and 'Heavy Stance Mastery Level 10.'
new_findings.ledger_text: 3. **The stance tables (dmg 0.9/1.2/1.4, reach 300/200/100) are MASTERY-9 CEILING values, not base.**
new_findings.lane_impact: L2 skills-meters + L5 combat-core - a one-word ledger fix (9 -> 10) that changes the whole mastery curve's domain.

new_findings.text: Reinforce-Weapon is flat 5000 coins across three material tiers, not two. InteractUI.as:657-673 reads the equipped weapon's level (with itemID 13022 forced to 59) and branches <30 / <60 / else onto strings 850 / 851 / 852, which read 'Cost: 5000 coins / Materials needed: 1 Silver Ore', '... 1 Titanium Ore' and '... 1 Uncut Diamond'. A weapon with no valid item (itemID 0 or 13000) gets string 849, which carries no cost line at all.
